prompts.prose:
FIRST FRAME
The clip opens on the supplied first frame and stays true to it: the same faces, hair, wardrobe, place and light.

STYLE
Photorealistic live-action television drama footage, real optics and natural imperfections. Available light, held frames.

SETTING
Kamala's house, dawn.

SUBJECTS
wearing a creased white shirt.

CAMERA
Camera: Medium close-up (medium close-up on Nimal), eye level; 50mm lens at f/2.8, a normal lens: natural perspective, as the eye sees it; focus: Shallow, soft background. Static: a steady, locked-off frame. As planned: locked-off, no camera movement. Camera on side A of the line of action: the action reads left to right. Grade: cool 6000K dawn warming, naturalistic, gently warm, film-like.

LIGHTING
Dawn, soft ambient: Pale early light, low and soft, cool shadows warming at the edges.

ACTION & DIALOGUE
Over 4 seconds:
0-2s: medium close-up. Nimal speak. Nimal (the man in a creased white shirt) says (quietly), "අම්මේ, මම ආපහු ආවා." — only Nimal's lips move.
2-4s: Nimal speak.

SOUND
Spoken dialogue only, exactly as written in the beats above and only from the named speakers. No narration, no voiceover. Room sound: natural sound of the location.

STYLE LOCK & CONSTRAINTS
Every person on screen who isn't the named speaker keeps their lips closed and still. All speech is in Sinhala, spoken naturally by a native speaker, exactly as written — not translated, not accented English. The setting, casting and everyday details are Sri Lankan. Rendering constraints: Clean, unmarked frame — no watermarks, no captions, no subtitles, no UI overlay. Surfaces and signage stay free of lettering. Anatomy stays natural and consistent: hands with five fingers, stable facial features, limbs that hold their proportions through the move. Solid objects — furniture, walls, props — are impenetrable: people move around them, never through them, and every contact carries natural weight. Objects stay put unless someone deliberately moves them. Gravity behaves normally and the camera move stays smooth and singular.

FORMAT
Aspect ratio 16:9. Duration 4 seconds. Ends on a cut.
